discussion_comments.comment_body: the `else` branch is not "non ai gateway requests", its unsuccessful requests, which wont have `usage` in the response body
we should hard error and log instead of falling back to `openai`
also, can you please indent this code, its not formatted properly 😭

i agree we want to make sure we always update the DO as much as possible, but I think we already have as many safeguards as we can? the `.log` function has try/catches around each individual fallible operation and then tries to continue gracefully as much as it possible can?

> where would we get res.data.cost from?
We should pull it out of the log function. There is a line in the log function that sends to kafka and then calculates the cost and shit. 

At the time i was just lazy, but we really dont need that all there. We can kill all the logic after we send to kafka (wheere the cost is calculated) and move that somewhere else so the walletManager doesn't have to rely on log success

+import { err, Result } from "../../packages/common/result";
+
+/**
+ * Backend HQL Error System
+ * This defines all error codes and handling for the HQL feature.
+ * The frontend has a separate, lighter-weight version for parsing and display.
+ */
+
+export enum HqlErrorCode {
+  // SQL Validation Errors
+  INVALID_STATEMENT = "HQL_INVALID_STATEMENT",
+  INVALID_TABLE = "HQL_INVALID_TABLE",
+  SYNTAX_ERROR = "HQL_SYNTAX_ERROR",
+  SQL_INJECTION_ATTEMPT = "HQL_SQL_INJECTION_ATTEMPT",
+  
+  // Query Execution Errors
+  QUERY_TIMEOUT = "HQL_QUERY_TIMEOUT",
+  MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED = "HQL_MEMORY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
+  ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED = "HQL_ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
+  RESULT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED = "HQL_RESULT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED",
+  EXECUTION_FAILED = "HQL_EXECUTION_FAILED",
+  
+  // Data Errors
+  NO_DATA_RETURNED = "HQL_NO_DATA_RETURNED",
+  SCHEMA_FETCH_FAILED = "HQL_SCHEMA_FETCH_FAILED",
+  
+  // Saved Query Errors
+  QUERY_NOT_FOUND = "HQL_QUERY_NOT_FOUND",
+  QUERY_NAME_EXISTS = "HQL_QUERY_NAME_EXISTS",
+  QUERY_ACCESS_DENIED = "HQL_QUERY_ACCESS_DENIED",
+  
+  // Validation Errors
+  MISSING_QUERY_ID = "HQL_MISSING_QUERY_ID",
+  MISSING_QUERY_NAME = "HQL_MISSING_QUERY_NAME",
+  MISSING_QUERY_SQL = "HQL_MISSING_QUERY_SQL",
+  QUERY_NAME_TOO_LONG = "HQL_QUERY_NAME_TOO_LONG",
+  
+  // Export Errors
+  CSV_UPLOAD_FAILED = "HQL_CSV_UPLOAD_FAILED",
+  CSV_URL_NOT_RETURNED = "HQL_CSV_URL_NOT_RETURNED",
+  
+  // Feature Access Errors
+  FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED = "HQL_FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED",
+  
+  // Generic Errors
+  UNEXPECTED_ERROR = "HQL_UNEXPECTED_ERROR",
+}
+
+export interface HqlError {
+  code: HqlErrorCode;
+  message: string;
+  details?: string;
+  statusCode?: number;
+}

this approach is also a lot more loose since you don't have essentially an enum of all possible error variants like you do with the `HqlErrorCode` (which is dope! very rusty).

but i think for TS I honestly just prefer the looser `BackendError` variant. i guess as they say, "when in rome, do as the romans do"

could be nice to console.error here instead of console.log.

More importantly, I don't think the `safePut` function is `throw`ing in the failure case when exceeding retries, so this `catch` block is never hit?
this is not caught. Please just return the `err` type and change the result type to be `Result<string, string>`

Oh, this was there in the alerts feature previously itself, so didn't take a look at it that well. My bad, will change it. Thank you!
Though, I have a question - shouldn't `Result<null, string>` be fine since SuccessResult is null and ErrorResult in the string?
